<function name="PreUndo" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>Called just before performing an undo.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2021.03.31</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="undo" type="table">The undo table. See <page text="Undo">Structures/Undo</page> struct.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return `false` to disallow the undo.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
